## What lives here
The typed API clients for every backend area, the shared axios client, the SSE reader and the query-key table.

## Conventions
Methods mirror the backend routes. Every response passes through `unwrap`. Query keys come from `QK` only.

## Entry points
`index.ts` (re-exports most groups) and `client.ts`.
